PO-7. NEVER MEASURE A TREE YOU ARE STILL EDITING, and never one somebody else
is editing either. Commit, confirm `git status` is empty, confirm HEAD has not
moved, then run. This session lost one full gate run to it, and the run
reported a FAIL that would have been blamed on working code.

PO-8. BEFORE DISPATCHING A WRITER LANE, CHECK WHETHER THE WORK ALREADY LANDED.
One `git log --oneline -5` in the target repository would have saved twenty
minutes and a killed agent. The fence system deliberately cannot see across
repositories, so this one is human discipline and says so.

PO-9. ASK THE CONTROL, DO NOT RE-DERIVE IT. The drift check refused a plan to
